page_title: STR 1-2 PSG | Strasbourg v PSG 01/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Eric Wattellier has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+7' PSG take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90+7' PSG quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
90+6' Eric Wattellier shows a yellow card to Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) for his blatant foul.
90+4' Gary O'Neil has decided to substitute Samir El Mourabet and he is replaced by Gessime Yassine (Strasbourg).
90+4' Samir El Mourabet (Strasbourg) meets a cross from the flank and shoots from around the penalty spot, but the ball flies totally wide of the left post.
90+2' Dangerous play by Samuel Amo-Ameyaw (Strasbourg). Eric Wattellier blows his whistle for a foul.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90' Martial Godo (Strasbourg) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
89' Mamadou Sarr (Strasbourg) is able to continue to play.
89' Marquinhos (PSG) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
86' Mamadou Sarr (Strasbourg) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
86' Marquinhos (PSG) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
85' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
84' Guela Doue (Strasbourg) times his run and jump perfectly to get on the end of the resulting corner, but the ball comes off the top of his head and goes miles over the bar.
84' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) will take the corner.

83' Guela Doue (Strasbourg) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. The referee blows his whistle, Strasbourg are awarded a corner kick.
82' Here is a change. Ben Chilwell is going off and Gary O'Neil gives the last tactical orders to Samuel Amo-Ameyaw (Strasbourg).
81' 1 - 2 Goal! Nuno Mendes (PSG) ran onto a clever lofted pass from Warren Zaire-Emery and easily beat the keeper with a header into the bottom right corner from close range. 1:2.
81' Rafael Luis (Strasbourg) makes a rough challenge and Eric Wattellier blows his whistle for a foul.
80' Ben Chilwell (Strasbourg) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
79' Desire Doue (PSG) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
78' 7:12 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
77' Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
75' The ref signals that VAR has overturned that yellow card and upgraded it to a straight red for Achraf Hakimi (PSG). He’s got to go!

75' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Achraf Hakimi (PSG), but referee Eric Wattellier must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
74' Tempers flare after Achraf Hakimi (PSG) commits a foul. He receives a yellow card for his bad challenge and surely must be relieved at not receiving a red card.
74' Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
72' Gary O'Neil decides to make a substitution. Julio Enciso (Strasbourg) will be replaced by Rafael Luis.
70' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Achraf Hakimi (PSG).
68' Kang-In Lee (PSG) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
67' Ben Chilwell (Strasbourg) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.

67' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out. Strasbourg have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

64' Kang-In Lee (PSG) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Mike Penders pulls off an easy save.
62' Kang-In Lee (PSG) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
60' The corner is swung in but PSG can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
60' Luis Enrique has decided to make a change. Kang-In Lee (PSG) replaces Bradley Barcola.
59' The referee allows time for a substitution. Senny Mayulu will be replaced by Ousmane Dembele (PSG).
59' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Achraf Hakimi (PSG). The linesman points to the corner flag, PSG are going to take it.
59' Desire Doue (PSG) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
57' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) latches onto the ball in the penalty box and takes a first-time effort that goes a couple of yards over the crossbar.
56' A clever short pass gives Desire Doue (PSG) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball well wide of the right post.
55' Guela Doue (Strasbourg) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Eric Wattellier blows his whistle for a foul.
51' Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) makes a strong challenge and Eric Wattellier blows for a foul.
50' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Ben Chilwell (Strasbourg) offside.
47' Strasbourg fail to score from a corner as Matvey Safonov (PSG) leaps to collect the ball.
46' The game is over for Ibrahim Mbaye (PSG). Desire Doue comes on for the second half.
46' Eric Wattellier blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+6' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
45' 5 additional min. will be played.
45' The game is interrupted now, Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

43' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) gets on the end of a pass inside the box and produces a promising first-time shot towards the bottom right corner. His effort is blocked by Mike Penders with a brilliant diving save!
42' The corner from Julio Enciso (Strasbourg) is hurriedly cleared.
41' Ben Chilwell (Strasbourg) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Matvey Safonov intercepts the ball. Strasbourg earn a corner.
40' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
39' Ben Chilwell (Strasbourg) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
38' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Strasbourg was in an offside position.
37' PSG can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
37' A cross into the box from Ibrahim Mbaye (PSG) is cleared. The ball goes out for a corner. PSG can continue in their attacking effort.
35' Eric Wattellier has a clear sight and sees a foul from Senny Mayulu (PSG).
34' Guela Doue (Strasbourg) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
33' Mike Penders is equal to the effort from the edge of the box by Achraf Hakimi (PSG), pushing the ball around the post to safety.
30' The ratio of the ball possession is 27:73.

27' 1 - 1 It's a goal! Guela Doue (Strasbourg) scores with a brilliant low shot into the middle of the goal after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Ben Chilwell. The score is now 1:1.
25' The PSG players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
22' 0 - 1 Goal! Senny Mayulu (PSG) pounced on a loose ball inside the penalty area and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 0:1.
20' Matvey Safonov anticipates the direction of the penalty by Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg). He attempted to put the ball inside the left post, but the goalkeeper was there in time to deny him.
20' Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) is going to take the penalty!
20' It’s a PENALTY to Strasbourg after the VAR review!

18' Play continues despite the shouts by some Strasbourg players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Eric Wattellier interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
17' Marquinhos (PSG) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
16' Willian Pacho (PSG) leaps like a salmon and powers a header in at goal from the corner, but his close-range effort is poor and goes way over the bar.
16' Nuno Mendes (PSG) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
14' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards the bottom right corner, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Matvey Safonov.
11' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Strasbourg.
8' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
5' Joao Neves (PSG) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
4' Neat passing move from PSG in order to create new attacking opportunities.
2' Senny Mayulu (PSG) commits a rough challenge and Eric Wattellier blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. PSG will have the kick-off.
